newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab shot dead near Jewish settlement in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Arab shot dead near Jewish settlement in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli police said on Sunday that a Palestinian was shot dead near a Jewish settlement in the West Bank on Sunday by attackers in a passing car.

"At the entrance to the Carmel settlement in the Hebron area there was shooting from a passing car -- no details about the car -- at a minority member (Palestinian). He died from his wounds," a police statement issued to the media said.
Israel's Channel Two Television, emphasising it was working from initial reports, quoted one witness as saying the car bore the yellow number plates issued to Israelis.
Since two suicide bombers killed 13 people at a Jewish market in Jerusalem on Wednesday, tension has been high in Israel and the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
Israel fears there will be more suicide attacks. There are also concerns that militant Jews may attack Palestinians in revenge for Wednesday's bombing.
